_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil statistics dominate and no 24h macro print or funding flush is present to force a rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: yes on current Panic phase; narrative silent on forward direction so analyst HOLD stands
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score holds 24-31 with BTC rangebound, funding near flat, no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and Fear & Greed <15 (down to Capitulation) or momentum reclaim with Fear & Greed >40 plus ETF inflows (up to Denial)
